about: Recorded demo data for Module 6 (MGMT 615, fictional). 'media' is each module's produced media after the refresh: kind (welcome, overview, teaching, scenario, closing, graphic, audio), title, minutes, where it's made (xr-stage, media-team, faculty-self), and its storyline connection. Curated videos belong to Module 5, not here. 'review' holds refresh flags and resolutions.
